front.title: DEMO TRIP
front.tagline: EVERY LAYOUT MECHANISM ON A FEW PAGES
intro: This book is built from generated test cards instead of real photos. Each card shows its idx and its printed number.
Copy this folder as the starting point for a real book.

days.title: Arrival
intro: The day-intro paragraph sits on the chapter opener, left of the small inset photo.

days.title: Panoramas and text
intro: A day can open with a two-page panorama, or carry one at its chronological position mid-day.
Grid cells can show a paragraph of text instead of a photo.

days.title: Edge to edge
intro: Pages that bleed into the trim area, and a photo forced onto its own page.

closing.caption: The last photo, on the closing spread
closing.lead: A lead-in line above the headline.
closing.headline: See you next time!

3.caption: A caption on a grid photo
